pages.text: $(bold)Three sockets. Cast on command.$()$(br2)Press the $(bold)Activate Bangle$() key (default $(bold)R$()) and every socketed gem fires at whatever you're aiming at — fireballs of intent, lightning, a blink. One shared cooldown follows, the sum of every gem's price.
$(bold)Three tiers.$()$(br2)Copper is the baseline. The gold bangle shaves $(bold)10%$() off that cooldown, and a netherite upgrade shaves $(bold)20%$().
A plain ring of copper for the wrist.
A solid ring of gold, cast faster.
Upgrade a gold bangle at a smithing table for the fastest cooldown.
